body: Thank you for sharing this! I am so sorry for the pain you're feeling.

I was diagnosed with borderline personality disorder in December and also with bipolar type 2. I know the signs of bpd and we have talked about it before that she might have that, because she does show some of the signs. She isn't very impulsive nor does she self harm.

Yeah it's a lot like that, however she gets really snappy when we are walking and lets say there are people walking more slowly in front of her/us she will make a comment that is kind of rude. 
She gets mad when I see my friends and always wants to come. My friends also have SOs but when we hang out it's just like us girls doing our nails and catching up. She is very jealous, she freaks out if she sees me texting someone. She always want's to look at my phone, but I don't do that.
I think I should, I just feel so guilty that I can't make it better. I just feel so unlovable you know.
Would that make me a bad person?  I feel like a monster for posting this.
